title: Introduction to Vector Databases
text: Vector databases store high-dimensional embeddings and support approximate or exact nearest-neighbor search. They are commonly used to power retrieval-augmented generation systems.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a retriever component with a language model. The retriever finds relevant documents before the model generates a response.

title: AsterixDB Overview
text: AsterixDB is a scalable, open-source big data management system that supports semi-structured data and SQL++ queries.

title: Sentence Embeddings
text: Sentence embeddings map variable length text into fixed length vectors, enabling similarity comparison via distance metrics such as cosine similarity.

title: K-Nearest Neighbor Search
text: K-nearest neighbor search finds the k closest points to a query point in a vector space, commonly used for classification and retrieval tasks.
